title: Helping a Stranger Without Expecting Thanks
paragraphs: Driving home late one night, Yumna saw a driver with a flat tire on a quiet road. She stopped at a safe distance and called roadside assistance.
She stayed in her locked car nearby until help arrived. She also gave the driver the phone number and made sure he could call a family member.
A week later, Yumna saw a local article about an anonymous person who had helped that night. She recognized the story but did not mention her role.
She told a close friend that helping quietly felt more sincere. For Yumna, the important thing was that someone reached safety.
